text:
Nadia Flores: quick heads-up 3 sample-app started spamming schema errors in staging when using JSON mode + streaming fncalls after the streaming change.
Ethan Kim: likely partial JSON chunks hitting the validator. any log snippet?
Nadia Flores: yeah:
```
[data] '{"call":{"name":"annotate","args":{"text":["x",'
[data] '"y"]}}'
validator: SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input
```
Priyanka Rao: SDKs currently try to parse each event. short-term fix: add an SDK helper that assembles a top-level JSON frame before validation. call it `collectTopLevelJsonFrame`.
Ethan Kim: add safety bounds (maxBytes=128KB, maxWaitMs=250ms) and a `partial` mode if exceeded so apps can fallback to NDJSON handling or request non-streaming.
Nadia Flores: parity needed: node async iterable + python async generator with same API. add unit tests for nested/braced strings and NDJSON tool outputs.
Priyanka Rao: also add telemetry `jsonframe_bytes` and `jsonframe_delay_ms` so we can tune defaults post-rollout.
build-bot: created issue #9012: "jsonframe collector for streaming fncalls"
Nadia Flores: I'll land a small TS prototype behind a feature flag and docs update in sample-app. Priyanka will take python mirror.
Ethan Kim: checklist: tests, parity, docs, telemetry, feature flag. LGTM.
